method: joint greedy one-card swaps from the locked Celebi roast; each step may add one Luvdisc, replace one Fire Energy with Water Energy, add one Slumbering Forest, or add one Switch; every legal cut is screened and the best few are confirmed; a step is kept only when the full Sisters-weighted win rate is higher than the list already kept; after that search stops, the best Luvdisc cuts are confirmed at 0, 1, 3, and 7 Water and the same greedy continues from the best of those lists, with Forest and Switch also confirmed together on the first package step
decision: The locked roast stays. No confirmed list beat 45.2% ± 0.5%. The highest Luvdisc confirm is +Luvdisc/-Evolution Incense/w0 at 44.4% (-0.8%). The highest confirm with Water Energy is +Luvdisc/-Evolution Incense/w3 at 43.9%. On 7 Water, Water Pulse fires 0.16 times per game. Greedy steps from that seed reach +Switch −Energy Retrieval at 44.5% (-0.7%). That step is inside one standard error of the seed. Forest and Switch together on the Luvdisc list confirm at 41.2%.
